  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <description>
      <![CDATA[
        Nested CDATA with special characters: <item>&ref-ent;</item>
      ]]>
      &ref-ent; &macro-ent;
    </description>
  </item>
</catalog>
